audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows are wrong against the packet levelChart and the already-applied mirror audit, which both read Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Irelia / Irelia. Rows 2 and 4 are labelled 'Skill' while whys[2] ends 'still win the extended fight you're forced into' and whys[4] ends 'his all-in still wins here'. Rows 5 and 6 are labelled 'Darius' while whys[6] ends 'the extended duel is now yours' and the late paragraph opens 'This is where you take over.' Ratings were also never re-scored — rows now owned by Irelia still carry 4/10.
audit.why: Darius owns every level from 1 to 6: Apprehend into five-stack Hemorrhage and an empowered Decimate beats anything Irelia has, and Noxian Guillotine only widens it at 6. From first item on, Bladesurge reset uptime and max Ionian Fervor out-DPS him in a long fight.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 4, 5 and 6 set to Darius / Darius / Irelia / Irelia in both layers, with ratings re-scored to match the sides.
sources: brief currentText whys[2], whys[4], whys[6], late

audit.whatIsWrong: No Darius cooldown appeared anywhere in the full layer despite Apprehend being named the matchup-defining cooldown in six places.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — a 26-second rank-1 cooldown is the longest window in the lane and the entire reason 'bait the pull' is playable advice. Noxian Guillotine is 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: The 26s figure written into dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) The page describes Ionian Fervor as 'armor/MR shred' in whys[5], whys[6], spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text, late and wants.you[2] — it shreds nothing; it is stacking bonus Attack Speed plus bonus on-hit damage at max stacks, and the healing in her kit is on Bladesurge. (b) Nothing says that Noxian Guillotine is TRUE damage and therefore passes straight through Defiant Dance, whose reduction is physical only. Crippling Strike's auto-attack reset as the burst tell was also absent.
audit.why: Riot's text: Irelia P — 'stacking bonus Attack Speed... at maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit'; Irelia W — 'reduced physical damage during the charge'; Darius R — 'dealing true damage', increased per Hemorrhage stack; Darius W carries the autoReset flag.
audit.corrected: whys[5], whys[6], spikes[2].text, dosFull[1].d and phases[4..6].why rewritten; the auto-reset tell added to report[5].t.
sources: enemyKit R text and trueDamage flag

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] recommends Plated Steelcaps and justifies anti-heal with 'his healing fights your pattern' without naming the source.
audit.why: The healing is Decimate's blade half. Separately, Apprehend passively makes his physical damage ignore a percentage of the target's Armor, so armour alone is a weaker answer here than the boots line implies.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal line now names Decimate. The armour-penetration point is flagged in notes rather than written, since I cannot size it from Riot's text.
sources: enemyKit Q text (heals based on champions hit by the blade)
enemyKit E text (passively ignores a percentage of Armor)

notes: The mirror audit deliberately left phase ratings untouched and raised it as an open question. I did re-score the four rows whose side I flipped, because leaving 'Irelia' rows at 4/10 renders a page that says she wins the stage and is losing it. If the ratings are meant to be owner-independent, rows 5 and 6 need reverting. Remaining 'armor/MR shred' fabrications I could not fit inside the length band: spikes[3].text, the late paragraph, and wants.you[2]. Also worth a champion-level look: Apprehend passively makes Darius's physical damage ignore a percentage of the target's Armor, which weakens the Plated Steelcaps recommendation in report[8] — I did not change the boots because Riot's text gives no percentage and I will not guess one.
